programme.title: Food Stories

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe.

programme.title: Inside Things
programme.desc: Intisari dasar dari cara kerja sesuatu dijelaskan hanya dengan menjelajahi dunia alami serta penemuan buatan manusia yang berhubungan dengan kita setiap hari atau sepanjang hidup kita.

programme.title: Inside Things
programme.desc: The basic nuts and bolts of how things work is explained simply by exploring the natural world as well as the man made inventions that we come in contact with every day or across our lives.

programme.title: Mindworks
programme.desc: Memahami cara kita berpikir dan memandang sesuatu dengan melakukan permainan otak. Seri hiburan faktual ini mengeksplorasi cara kita melihat dan memahami dunia di sekitar kita dengan percobaan, kegiatan, demonstrasi dan penjelasan.

programme.title: Mindworks
programme.desc: Understanding how we think and see by playing games with our brains. This factual entertainment series explores the way we see and interpret the world around us with engaging tests, activities, demonstrations and explanations.

programme.title: More Curious?
programme.desc: Apakah dunia sekitar membuat Anda kagum? Ingin tahu bagaimana barang bekerja atau dari mana asalnya? Jangan heran lagi, cari tahu tentang cara kerja dan asal usul benda sehari-hari serta penjelasan untuk ide dan konsep di sekitar kita.

programme.title: More Curious?
programme.desc: Do you find yourself marvelling at the world around you? Ever wonder how stuff works or where it came from? Wonder no more, find out about the inner workings and origins of everyday things as well explanations for ideas and concepts that surround us.

programme.title: Rethink
programme.desc: Di dunia yang serba di luar dugaan, terkadang Anda hanya perlu mundur selangkah dan melihat sekali lagi. Temukan hal-hal yang benar-benar aneh dan luangkan waktu untuk berpikir ulang.

programme.title: Rethink
programme.desc: In a world where nothing is what it seems, sometimes you just need to take a step back and take a second look. Discover the weird, quaint and downright bizarre and take the time to re-think.

programme.title: Wild About
programme.desc: Menghibur, mengedukasi dan memikat. Hewan dan alam disatukan dalam format dokumenter yang menarik secara visual. Seri ini menyajikan kehidupan dan ciri-ciri yang menentukan dari beberapa hewan yang luar biasa di dunia.

programme.title: Wild About
programme.desc: Entertaining. Educational. Engaging. Animals and nature instinctively brought together in a visually stimulating documentary format. This series is a detailed journey into the life and defining traits of some of the worlds most majestic and curious animals.

programme.title: Animal Society
programme.desc: Mari kita jelajahi Kerajaan Hewan dan melihat dari dekat bagaimana keluarga hewan hidup bersama. Saksikan bagaimana keluarga berbagai jenis hewan bekerja dan hidup bersama, saling melindungi lalu pergi meninggalkan keluarganya untuk berjuang sendiri.

programme.title: Animal Society
programme.desc: We explore the Animal Kingdom and look closely at how animal tribes/families live together. We see common themes in how animal families work and live together, protect each other and then go off to fend for themselves across a range of species.

programme.title: Ancient Grains
programme.desc: Saat membuka dapur, apakah gambar pergunungan terjal di Amerika Selatan, dataran tinggi Afrika yang penuh warna dan lembah sungai subur di Timur Tengah menari di depan mata Anda?

programme.title: Ancient Grains
programme.desc: When you open your pantry, do images of the rugged mountains of South America, the colorful tablelands of Africa and the fertile river valleys of the Middle East dance before your eyes?

programme.title: Ancient Grains

programme.title: Busy Bodies

programme.title: Cities of the World
programme.desc: Tiket kelas satu menuju kota-kota di dunia. Kunjungi kota-kota besar dan kecil di seluruh dunia untuk mengungkap ikon, budaya, wisata, dan fitur tersembunyi mereka beserta informasi tentang kebiasaan, kepribadian, dan sejarah lokal.

programme.title: Cities of the World
programme.desc: Your first class ticket to the cities of the world. This factual series features large and small cities from around the world to reveal their icons, culture, tourist and hidden highlights with information about local custom, personality and history.

programme.title: Cultural Flavours
programme.desc: Setiap episode Cultural Flavours memberi pemirsa gambaran tentang kehidupan di seputar meja makan dari negara yang berbeda. Di setiap episode, karakteristik unik masakan lokal ditampilkan, dan setelah itu setiap resep dibuat ulang dari awal.

programme.title: Cultural Flavours
programme.desc: Each episode of Cultural Flavours provides viewers with a snapshot of life around the dinner table of a different country. In every episode, the unique characteristics of local cuisine are shown, and afterwards each recipe is recreated step-by-step.

programme.title: Curious?

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Diary Of Supir

programme.title: Baju Orange Jangan Sampai Lolos
programme.desc: Bara adalah mahasiswa S2 yang kaya, keren, dan sudah memiliki pacar. Kehidupannya tampak berjalan dengan lancar hingga suatu hari dia bertemu gadis petugas pembersih sampah yang menamparnya dengan kenyataan.

programme.title: Baju Orange Jangan Sampai Lolos
programme.desc: Bara is a master's student who is rich, admirable, and already has a girlfriend. His life seems to be going smoothly until one day he meets a garbage cleaning girl who slaps him with reality.

programme.title: Nina Bobo
programme.desc: Hantu anak perempuan Belanda bernama Nina Van Mijk menghantui rumah yang dulu ditinggalinya. Keluarga muda yang menempatinya sekarang tidak peduli mitos yang berkembang di masyarakat, meskipun Wina, sang anak menyadari keberadaan hantu Nina di rumah itu.

programme.title: Nina Bobo
programme.desc: A ghost of a Dutch girl named Nina Van Mijk haunted the house she once lived. A young familiy who now lives there doesn't care about the myths spread among the community, although Wina, their daughter, realizes the existence of Nina's ghost in the house.

programme.title: 31 Tahun Jomblo
programme.desc: Monique adalah seorang wanita mandiri yang populer dan sukses dengan pekerjaannya. Akan tetapi Monique belum menikah, bahkan belum memiliki pacar. Sampai suatu ketika dia dihadapkan dengan sebuah dilema, adiknya akan menikah dengan mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: 31 Tahun Jomblo
programme.desc: Monique is an independent, success, and popular woman. But she hasn't married and doesn't have a boyfriend either. Until one day, she faces a dilemma, her sister will get married to her ex.

programme.title: The Perfect Boyfriend
programme.desc: Gwen dan Ogi adalah dua sahabat yang dikecewakan dengan mantan pacar mereka. Lalu mereka menciptakan sesosok pria idaman dengan memakai ilmu sihir. Namun. ternyata persahabatan mereka terancam karena keduanya sama-sama menyukai pria buatan mereka itu.

programme.title: The Perfect Boyfriend
programme.desc: Gwen and Ogi are two best friends who are disappointed with their exes. Therefore, they create a perfect boyfriend with witchcraft. However, turns out that their friendship is in jeopardy as they both like that same guy they have made.

programme.title: Maling Teriak Cinta
programme.desc: Hubungan Joni dan Aisya tidak disetujui karena Joni pengangguran. Kemudian Joni ditawari merampok rumah Reno oleh Pepeng. Ternyata Joni mirip dengan Reno. Karin pacar Reno yang materialistis memanfaatkan hal ini untuk memeras Joni.

programme.title: Maling Teriak Cinta
programme.desc: Joni and Aisya's relationship wasn't approved due to him being unemployed. Pepeng then took Joni to help him robbing Reno's home. It turns out Joni and Reno's faces are similar. Karin, Reno's materialistic girlfriend uses this to blackmail Joni.

programme.title: Cintaku Sewangi Kue Rangi
programme.desc: Lala adalah gadis cantik Betawi asli yang ditaksir banyak lelaki, tapi gadis ini tampak tak memedulikan semua yang mendekati. Ayahnya pun menjadi cemas. Akankah Lala menemukan pria idamannya?

programme.title: Cintaku Sewangi Kue Rangi
programme.desc: Lala is a pretty Betawi girl with many men wagging their tails before her, but she paid no attention to them at all. Her father became concerned about her love life, will Lala meet the man of her dream?

programme.title: From Tulang Becomes Love
programme.desc: Bisma mengalami cedera kaki saat main futsal, tapi sayangnya dia takut jarum suntik, sehingga dia menolak dibawa ke RS. Akhirnya, dia dibawa ke tukang urut biasa. Sialnya, dia malah bertemu Mila, mantannya.

programme.title: From Tulang Becomes Love
programme.desc: Bisma was injured when he played futsal, but he's afraid of needles, so he refused to be brought to the hospital. In the end, he went to a traditional massage clinic. But he instead met Mila, his ex.

programme.title: Ketika Hantu Fall In Love
programme.desc: Laura yang baru saja dilamar justru memergoki tunangannya selingkuh. Dikuasai emosi, dia langsung berlari, tapi naasnya dia mengalami kecelakaan. Tiba-tiba dia tersadar, tapi segalanya menjadi aneh.

programme.title: Ketika Hantu Fall In Love
programme.desc: Laura who just got proposed caught the so called fiance cheated on her. Consumed by anger, she ran away, and got hit by a speeding car. When she came to, everything became so weird.

programme.title: Queen Of Comblang
programme.desc: Dara, tukang comblang andalan biro jodoh Baper Comblang mendapat tugas unik. Vanka, sahabat lamanya tiba-tiba muncul dan menangis karena menolak dijodohkan orang tuanya.

programme.title: Queen Of Comblang
programme.desc: Dara, the matchmaker for matchmaking agency Baper Comblang, gets a unique assignment. Vanka, her old best friend suddenly appears and cries because she refuses to be matched by her parents.

programme.title: Gerabah Tanah Kuburan
programme.desc: Setelah dikabarkan ayahnya sakit, Ardi terpaksa harus pulang ke rumahnya di Bogor. Ternyata kepulangan Ardi disambut dengan berita duka. Ayahnya telah meninggal dunia berpesan kalau Ardi harus meneruskan usaha Ayahnya. Namun Ardy tidak tahu caranya.

programme.title: Gerabah Tanah Kuburan
programme.desc: After hearing the news about his father dying, Ardi went back to his home at Bogor. But unfortunately, his father passed away. His father's will was that Ardi must continue his business, and Ardi doesn't know how.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat: Tusuk Rambut Sin Yen
programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat yang berjanji untuk tidak saling berebut pacar. Tapi semenjak Ratih memakai tusuk rambut milik Mama Sinta, Ratih selalu menggoda Remon pacar Sinta dan dia dihantui oleh arwah pemilik tusuk rambut itu sebelumnya.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat: Tusuk Rambut Sin Yen
programme.desc: The story of two best friends who promised not to usurp each other's boyfriend. But since Ratih wear a hair slide belongs to Sinta's mother, Ratih is always teasing Sinta's boyfriend, Remon and she is haunted by the ghost of the previous owner of the hair slide.

programme.title: Move On Yang Tertunda
programme.desc: Amel bertemu dengan Aldo karena sebuah peristiwa tak mengenakkan, tapi bunga cinta perlahan bersemi di antara mereka. Sialnya, sebenarnya Amel sudah dijodohkan dengan orang lain.

programme.title: Move On Yang Tertunda
programme.desc: Amel met Aldo due to an unfortunate situation, but love grows bit by bit between them. Alas, Amel was actually about to be married off to another man.

programme.title: Asmara Segede Bakpao
programme.desc: Suatu hari, Rossa tak sengaja membuat seorang pria marah karena menyenggol motornya dan bertengkar. Namun, ternyata mereka selalu tak sengaja bertemu, apa ini pertanda sesuatu?

programme.title: Asmara Segede Bakpao
programme.desc: One day, Rossa accidentally made a guy mad after bumping on his bike. Then, they had a fight, but they ended up always meeting up somewhere, is the universe trying to tell her something?

programme.title: Kasih Tak Santai
programme.desc: Kemal dan Ranti adalah sepasang kekasih yang rupawan dan trendi. Ketika Kemal berkunjung ke rumah Ranti, ayahnya dan ibu Ranti yang sama-sama sedang puber kedua, menunjukkan tanda kasmaran. Akankah ini berdampak buruk untuk Kemal?

programme.title: Kasih Tak Santai
programme.desc: Kemal and Ranti are young, beautiful, and the it couple. When Kemal visits Ranti's house, his father and Ranti's mother who are going through their second puberty, look taken to each other. Will this impact negatively on Kemal?

programme.title: Sweet Gudeg Siapa Yang Punya
programme.desc: The story of Dafa and Salma, two people with opposite personalities, began with an accidental bumping on each other. The two of them had quarrelled afterwards, but will it end as sweetly as the gudeg that Salma cooks?

programme.title: Tersengat Cinta Sepeda Listrik
programme.desc: Radit is a leader of environmental NGO who always butt heads with Kayla, a biker girl who is offended by his campaign which claims that her motorbike is one of the biggest pollutants.

programme.title: Pacarku Pelupa

programme.title: Pacarku Pelupa
programme.desc: Abi is a hardworking man who is successful and rich, but he is so forgetful that it impacts negatively on his personal life. Luckily he has Adel, a diligent secretary who is always ready beside him.

programme.title: Pacarku Superdad
programme.desc: Stella adalah seorang gadis cantik yang sudah bertunangan dengan Vano, seorang duda dengan 2 anak. Orang tua dan anak Vano tidak menyukai Stella, namun kekuatan cinta keduanya yang akhirnya mengalahkan semua prasangka.

programme.title: Pacarku Superdad
programme.desc: Stella is a beautiful girl who is engaged to Vano, a widower with two children. Vano's parents and children do not like Stella, but the power of their love is eventually able to defeat all prejudices.

programme.title: Anak Tong Kosong

programme.title: Anak Ujung Petir

programme.title: Cinta Jebakan Betmen
programme.desc: When she's going to the campus, Saras failed to hail a ride many times. She then ran because she's already late to class, but on the way to campus, there's a car hitting the water puddle on her. Despite the owner is handsome, Saras is still angry!

programme.title: Ramadhan, I Miss U

programme.title: Hidup Kedua

programme.title: Para Pencari Tuhan Jilid 18 Dunia Sementara, Coy!
programme.desc: Jack dan Galak yang berusaha mencarikan pekerjaan bagi anggota DPR yang masih menganggur. Kekhawatiran muncul karena jika dibiarkan terlalu lama, kondisi ini bisa berujung pada tindakan kriminal. Sementara itu, Udin, yang sebelumnya bekerja sebagai hansip, kini menganggur dan terpaksa mencuri di rumah sahabatnya, Asrul, demi menghidupi istrinya.

programme.title: Para Pencari Tuhan Jilid 18 Dunia Sementara, Coy!
programme.desc: Jack and Galak are trying to find jobs for unemployed members of the House of Representatives. Concerns arise because if left too long, this condition could lead to criminal acts.
